description: This file defines a Java class that extends a performance testing base class for launch performance testing of a specific activity in an Android application. It sets up the intent to launch 'com.android.launchperf.ComplexActivity' and performs the launch in the 'onStart' method, then finishes with a result code.

classes.name: ComplexActivityLaunchPerformance
classes.description: A class for measuring the performance of launching a specific complex activity in Android, extending LaunchPerformanceBase.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the intent for the activity to launch and initiates the launch process.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Performs the launch and then finishes the test with a success result.
